info.name: LJVIS — Foreign Violation Form
info.description: Functional tests for /control-forms/foreign-violation-form endpoints. Covers permission boundaries, backend validation (required fields), version/status lifecycle (saved -> confirmed -> published), locked-after-confirm, the saved-state no-version-bump rule, and the edit_locked-gated re-save of confirmed/published data (officer blocked, admin allowed with version bump). Self-contained: authenticates and creates its own test data.
